Through the development of reporting frameworks, dashboards, visualisations, and analytical models, the Data Analyst provides actionable recommendations that drive performance, identify trends, improve efficiency, and support organisational objectives.   The Data Analyst ensures that data is managed ethically, securely, and in accordance with organisational governance frameworks, privacy obligations, and regulatory requirements.    Benefits   Career growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding organisation.    Opportunity to influence strategic business decisions.    Collaborative and supportive team culture.    Exposure to organisation-wide projects and stakeholders.    Autonomy and ownership of key initiatives.    Ongoing professional development and learning opportunities. improvement initiatives.     Task & responsibilities   Data Management & Governance       Develop, implement, and maintain processes for the secure collection, storage, processing, validation, and management of organisational data.   Ensure data is managed in accordance with organisational policies, privacy legislation, and data governance frameworks.   Monitor data quality across systems and identify inconsistencies, duplication, inaccuracies, or gaps.   Conduct regular audits and validation checks to ensure the integrity, reliability, and accuracy of data.   Develop and maintain data utilisation.   Assist departments in improving data capture processes and reporting methodologies.     Data Analysis & Insights     Analyse large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, risks, opportunities, and performance indicators.   Interpret operational, financial, workforce, participant, and organisational data to support business decision-making.   Respond to data-related queries and provide timely analytical support to internal stakeholders.   Develop statistical models and analytical methodologies to solve business problems and answer strategic questions.   Identify emerging trends and provide recommendations based on evidence and data-driven insights.   Translate complex data into practical recommendations for operational and executive teams.     Reporting & Visualisation     Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, reports, scorecards, and visualisations that provide meaningful business insights.   Produce regular operational, financial, workforce, compliance, and executive reporting as required.   Present findings through clear, concise, and visually engaging reports and presentations.   Communicate analytical outcomes to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.   Ensure reporting outputs are accurate, relevant, timely, and aligned with business objectives.   Support leadership teams with data required for strategic planning, forecasting, budgeting, and organisational performance reviews.     Systems, Automation & Development     Utilise analytical tools and technologies to improve reporting efficiency and organisational visibility.   Develop automated reporting solutions where appropriate to reduce manual processing and improve accuracy.   Write, maintain, and optimise scripts, queries, and code to support data extraction, transformation, analysis, and reporting activities.   Work collaboratively with internal technology teams to enhance reporting capabilities and system integrations.   Support the development of data models and business intelligence solutions.   Identify opportunities to leverage technology and automation to improve organisational performance and decision-making.     Stakeholder Engagement     Partner with department leaders to understand reporting requirements and business challenges.   Provide guidance and support to staff regarding data interpretation and reporting outputs.   Build strong working relationships across all departments to ensure data is utilised effectively.   Facilitate data-informed decision-making by providing accurate, reliable, and actionable insights.   Support organisational projects through the provision of analytical expertise and reporting requirements.     Compliance, Risk & Quality     Ensure all data handling activities comply with privacy, confidentiality, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements.   Maintain appropriate controls to safeguard organisational and participant information.   Identify and escalate risks relating to data quality, integrity, security, or governance.   Support internal audits, external audits, accreditation requirements, and compliance reporting activities.   Contribute to continuous
